SELECT CAST(p.id AS CHAR) AS id, p.process_name AS processName, p.process_code AS processCode, p.status, p.design_status AS designStatus, p.draft_schema_json AS draftSchemaJson FROM ai_business_process p
WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.subject_object_code = #{objectCode} AND p.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY p.update_time DESC, p.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_business_process SET draft_schema_json = #{schemaJson}, draft_schema_hash = #{schemaHash}, subject_object_id = #{subjectObjectId}, subject_object_code = #{subjectObjectCode}, design_status = #{designStatus}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0 AND draft_schema_hash = #{expectedSchemaHash}
